assertions.assertion: The claim was for CPT code 93229.
CPT 93229 corresponds to mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring.
The claim was denied under reason code CO-197.
The CO-197 denial was for lack of precertification/authorization.
The clinical indication note documents recurrent episodes of palpitations, lightheadedness, and intermittent syncope.
These symptoms are suggestive of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation.
Paroxysmal atrial fibrillation is coded as I48.0.
These symptoms are suggestive of sick sinus syndrome.
Sick sinus syndrome is coded as I49.5.
The note records a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction.
Personal history of TIA and cerebral infarction is coded as Z86.73.
Continuous ambulatory monitoring is indicated to detect arrhythmic events and guide anticoagulation and rate-control management.
Reconsideration is requested on medical necessity grounds.
